comment: The derived-code manifest: one group per emitted file, its imports, its carriers in
dependency order, the `--kind` requests (a `Content` instance right after that carrier's
`Canonical` one), and the acceptance guards appended verbatim after the generated
declarations. It is the manifest of docs/research/2026-09-04-cas-trait-plan.md §4 at its
landing paths, read by tools/Effect4Gen/Driver.lean on every machine with a Lean
toolchain. The manifest is the authority on the group's arguments.
Adding a group -- Machine, Tape and Log are owed at X2 -- is an entry here and no code
Out and Guards retain their legacy backslash argument spelling. The driver stages
those paths for the host filesystem. Main prints forward-slash reproduction paths
in the generated header, including when a checker redirects the output to a temporary file.
An applied type is one word with `@` for the space, so no shell ever splits it.

groups.Note: The Schema carriers hold `Json` and `Float64` fields, whose instances are the Json group's.
groups.Name: Schema

groups.Note: `Tree` is the store's own carrier (a name space as content, Store/Node.lean); its instance is emitted here beside `Pin`'s so no area above the store supplies a store type's instance (coordinator, 2026-09-05, after lane C's note).
groups.Name: Pin
